purpose: Canonical Gate 2 slot -> approved asset mapping (1 slot = 1 visual shot) for the Gate-2-approved v07 visual baseline. Identifies every approved asset without reference to the rough-cut working set: provider, source page, download URL, creator, license, pixel size, approved in-point, v07 film timing, local file name, byte count and sha256 of the approved bytes.

closedExceptions: N015-S2: the single v06 exception was re-sourced at v07 (Pexels 7113136) and accepted by the human in final context.

invariants.stillMotionPolicy: STATIC (no-motion-stills): stills are fixed scale + center crop, never Ken Burns / push-in / pan; verified by SSIM >= 0.98 and blend-diff Y <= 4.0 in the v07 motion QA
invariants.downloadsConvention: approved bytes are identified by localName + bytes + sha256. They materialize at the ASSETS stage under projects/ESSY-0005/sourcing/downloads/<localName>, following projects/ESSY-0004/sourcing/downloads/provenance.json. localPath stays null until then, except the in-repo generated clip, which is already at its permanent path.

items.durationSource: ffprobe of the approved local file named by localName (sha256 re-verified at materialization)
items.selectionNote: v05 AGENT PROVISIONAL SELECTION. Replaces 6376122, which solved the dark/stylized problem but introduced an editorial one: an isolated white square object on a wooden table read as a product shot and made the viewer wonder what the object was. Re-sourced with room-scale, lived-in vocabulary instead of the object vocabulary that produced it. 'a study table' is an ordinary resting work surface carrying the block's first beat (tools at rest), and it is a whole surface rather than one isolated item, so there is nothing to identify. Measured: the LEAST concentrated detail of every candidate screened (topShare 0.170 and gini 0.220 against the rejected clip's 0.231/0.276, activeCells 47/48 against 45/48), natural colour inside the film band (sat 0.257, blue 0.178), and real camera life rather than a still: the rejected clip measured all-zero motion on every axis, i.e. a still image encoded as video, which is exactly why it read as a product shot. Motion REVIEW (zoom 0.463%, pan 2.652%, shake 0.961px, rot 0.518deg), i.e. mild handheld, which is the anti-product-shot register. Report N014-S1 to revert.
